notes: What PoB's locked configs do not count for a support gem on the main skill. 'clear' is a judged multiplier on how fast a pack dies (more targets hit per use); the objective adds clear_weight x log(product, capped at clear_cap) in every profile, because the score is the minimum over profiles. 'conditional' is damage PoB only shows with a config switch on: more = the gem's more-damage while the state holds, share = the fraction of the time it holds per profile. It adds log(1 + more x share) to the objective and leaves the reported DPS as measured. Families: lower case, no tier.
